decisions.text: type step: an irregular series of states, each holding until the next: a step chart, never a standard line (G1.53)
zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)

a step chart: each value level from its change to the next, then straight up or down to the new one; 13 changes; the last value (250) runs to the end of the axis, the as-of date, June 30, 2022 (G7.19, D-42); no markers
a true time axis (G2.42), from the first value to the end of the as-of day: Apr. 1, 2022 to June 30, 2022
the unit phrase on the top label: “$500 (price of the TV)”; the top gridline starts after it
a true time axis (G2.42): row 1 months, each centred on its span
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
